UNDERSTANDING RESPONSE AND COORDINATION
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding response and coordination means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Response and Coordination.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Response and Coordination. Get clear on response and coordination before moving on. How would you explain response and coordination to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Explain Response and Coordination within Response and Coordination using correct terms and a clear example or calculation. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• In animals, coordination often uses the nervous system: receptors detect stimuli, neurones carry impulses, effectors respond.
• A reflex arc is a fast automatic pathway: stimulus → receptor → sensory neurone → relay → motor neurone → effector.
• Synapses are junctions where the impulse is passed chemically between neurones.
• Do not describe plant tropisms using neurones — plants coordinate mainly with hormones and growth.
• Exam tip: sequence the arc correctly and name each part; missing the synapse or relay loses marks.
